limitations: RSS peaks are sampled lower bounds; CPU is /proc jiffy-quantized and final observation precedes exit.
Send and local writer elapsed include scheduling/serialization effects, not isolated HTTP/2 blocking.
Clock bound assumes shared host/time namespace and CLOCK_MONOTONIC; start/end bound does not prove arbitrary unobserved transients.
gRPC wire payload bytes exclude HTTP/2; plaintext TCP-stream counts include HTTP/2 but exclude packets/retransmissions.
